description.7.0: Assign the specified property to all elements in the range.
description.9.0: Assigns properties to pile elements in the range. Properties include coupling-cohesion, coupling-cohesion-shear, coupling-cohesion-table, coupling-confining-flag, coupling-confining-table, coupling-friction, coupling-friction-shear, coupling-friction-table, coupling-gap, coupling-stiffness, coupling-stiffness-shear, cross-sectional-area, density, direction, moi-polar, moi, perimeter, plastic-moment, poisson, rockbolt-flag, slide, slide-tolerance, tensile-failure-strain, yield-compression, yield-tension, thermal-expansion, young, plastic-shear, shear-coefficient, spacing, and more. The properties consist of constitutive model properties, beam-type properties, coupling-spring properties and rockbolt properties. The constitutive model property names are primary keywords, but are not included in the list above. The following properties are available, with the constitutive model properties listed first.
normal coupling spring cohesion per unit length
shear coupling spring cohesion per unit length

keywords.name: coupling-cohesion-table
keywords.description: name of the table relating cohesion of shear coupling spring to relative shear displacement

description.7.0: flag to activate incremental confining stress logic (default: off)
description.9.0: flag to activate incremental confining stress logic

keywords.name: coupling-confining-table
keywords.description: name of the table relating effective confining stress factor to deviatoric stress

keywords.name: coupling-friction-table
keywords.description: name of the table relating friction angle of shear coupling spring to relative shear displacement

description.9.0: direction-y vector whose projection onto the element cross-section defines the \(y\) -axis of the element coordinate system

description.7.0: second moment with respect to local \(y\)-axis, \(I_y\)
description.9.0: moment of inertia with respect to element \(y\) -axis

description.7.0: second moment with respect to local \(z\)-axis, \(I_z\)
description.9.0: moment of inertia with respect to element \(z\) -axis
plastic moment capacity in Y and Z

description.7.0: plastic moment about the local Y direction, \(M_y^P\)
plastic moment about the local Z direction, \(M_z^P\)

keywords.name: plastic-shear
keywords.description: plastic shear capacity in Y and Z

keywords.name: shear-coefficient-y
keywords.description: shear coefficient for transverse shear deformation in the \(y\) -direction (Timoshenko beam only)

keywords.name: shear-coefficient-z
keywords.description: shear coefficient for transverse shear deformation in the \(z\) -direction (Timoshenko beam only)
